description: HR platform holding employee records, time off, and onboarding.

auth.label: BambooHR API key
auth.field_hint: Generated from your BambooHR profile, under API Keys.
auth.setup_notes: In BambooHR, open your profile menu, choose API Keys, and generate a new one. You also need your company subdomain, which is the part before .bamboohr.com in your URL.

capabilities.description: Fires when a new employee record is added in BambooHR.

poll_interval_minutes.description: How often to check for new employee records, in minutes. Ignored on platforms where this lowers to a webhook.

work_email.description: Often empty for a brand new hire, which is why onboarding flows construct the address rather than reading it.

rate_limit.notes: BambooHR throttles per subdomain, so a short poll interval across several workflows adds up.
